desc:
Welcome to +1 Jetpack for Brainrots 🚀🧠

Blast through crazy obstacle walls, fly farther, and collect the rarest Brainrots! Upgrade your jetpack boost, reach insane speeds, and explore new areas as you become faster! 🌌

How to play:
🚀 Use your jetpack to fly across each area
🧠 Collect Brainrots to earn Cash
⚡ Gain +1 Jetpack Boost every time you progress
💵 Upgrade your Brainrots to boost your income
🏗️ Expand your base to unlock more storage slots
🎁 Open Lucky Blocks for awesome rewards
🪨 Dodge obstacles and keep flying forward!

💤 Your Brainrots generate Cash even while OFFLINE!

Rebirth to multiply your cash! ♻️

🔥 Unlock powerful new Brainrots and reach the highest tiers!

👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE rewards!
